Only that one small line separates the base from the Premium. No user photo of the base bottle was found; all three proposals are shop studio shots.

hunter-08: two label generations. Current, and the catalogue bottle: OVAL navy label, gold outer ring, gold griffin, ЗОЛОТАЯ БАЛКА, Брют белое in italic, and the three lines РОССИЙСКОЕ ИГРИСТОЕ ВИНО С ЗГУ КРЫМ. Rejected candidates: Балаклава Reserve Brut and Гранд Капитал, which otzovik lists under the same product.

hunter-08: the discriminator between releases is the signature block. The 2021 release on the catalogue bottle carries THREE signatures (ОСМАНОВ, СИНИЦКИЙ, ВАТАМАН) with a GOLD cellar engraving. The 2022 release that cigarpro now stocks carries only TWO (ОСМАНОВ, ШПИЛЬ). Also beware of plain Массандра Саперави (otzovik product 490625), a different label entirely, and of Массандра Авторское Каберне, which bestwine24 shows under a Саперави search.

hunter-08: two label generations. hunter-08: the Уроки французского front label has THREE generations. G1: Latin CHATEAU de TALU plus the grape in Latin (CABERNET FRANC, MERLOT, CHARDONNAY). G2, which is the catalogue bottle: Latin CHATEAU de TALU plus the grape in Cyrillic (КАБЕРНЕ ФРАН). G3, current in shops and in 2024-2026 reviews: Cyrillic ШАТО де ТАЛЮ plus the grape in Cyrillic. G2 is a short transitional design, so only cru.ru still shows it for Каберне Фран. The illustration also identifies the grape: bicycles are Каберне Фран, a photographer with a tripod is Мерло, badminton is Шардоне, an easel painter is Сира.

hunter-12: the catalogue bottle of this slug is NOT a bottle. bottle_path points at Screenshot_20_47de2b4b32.webp, a landscape photo of a winery lawn with marquees. The official page vino-svoe.ru/wines/czitronnyj-magaracha shows the same wrong picture. The wine is Табия Цитронный Магарача, a dry white of the family winery Табия (Andrey Lysov) in Gostagaevskaya, Anapa, Krasnodar Krai. Its label is white with a red chess king, ТАБИЯ at the top and Цитронный Магарача at the foot. The siblings of the line share the layout and differ only in the chess piece colour and the grape line: Буковинка purple bishop on white, Мерло yellow queen on black, and there are also Рислинг, Каберне Совиньон and Рубин Голодриги.
